subject: EmbeddedPkg/PrePiLib: Prevent overread with FFS size macros
reasons: Replaces a repeated unsafe pattern '*(UINT32 *)(header->Size) & 0x00FFFFFF' with the safe macro FFS_FILE_SIZE(header) across 4 sites in one file.
Adjacent commit 9989454219 applies the exact same transformation to EmulatorPkg/SecPeiServicesLib/FwVol.c, and also adds SECTION_SIZE(section) for the section size variant.
Together these two commits form a series applying the same FFS size macro migration across multiple FwVol.c implementations — high repetitiveness as a conceptual group.
The before/after pattern is structurally identical and well-defined: replace raw pointer cast + mask with standardized macro.
